steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. PMI sets specific thresholds for both; review your academic credentials and work history against PMI's requirements before applying. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you verify eligibility at no charge.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp. Our instructor-led course delivers the full PMI contact-hour requirement online, on a schedule built for working professionals in Naperville's healthcare, telecommunications, energy, and financial-services sectors. Attend from your office or home; no travel required.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with your course completion proof from Granite PM Academy. Pay PMI's exam fee and allow processing time. Our team guides you through each required field to ensure accuracy and avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll take the exam online; pass it and you earn the PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. During that cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, volunteer work, or formal education. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to help you renew efficiently and stay current in your field.
